title: What is Freshsales?
text:
Freshsales is an easy-to-use, AI-powered customer relationship management (CRM) software solution built by Freshworks. With Freshsales, sales teams can organize, sell smarter, close deals faster, and scale stronger. Freshsales brings sales and marketing teams and tools together on one unified platform to make it easier to personalize customer conversations, boost sales conversions, and power productivity.

...

Learn more

## What are Freshsales’ pricing options?

Freshsales offers a variety of pricing plans to suit different business needs. Plans range from the Growth tier to the fully featured Enterprise tier. Freshsales also has a free plan for small teams of up to three users who want to manage customer data efficiently. Current pricing plans:

### Growth

Includes everything startups and SMBs need to organize customer data, manage sales pipeline, and engage across channels

### Pro

Ideal for growing and mid-sized businesses; includes AI and advanced features for pipeline management and automation

### Enterprise

For mid- to large-sized businesses that need advanced customization and governance capabilities

...

21-day free trial. No credit card required. No strings attached.
